responsibility: Defines the MN10300 target’s machine constraints for the RTL matcher and reload/LRA logic. It assigns register classes to constraint letters for data, address, stack, MDR, extended, floating-point, and accumulator registers, makes several of those constraints conditional on AM33/AM33_2 support, and defines memory, PIC-symbol, integer-immediate, and floating-point-zero constraints that mn10300.md patterns use to select valid operands and encodings.
